title: Pantry-aware planner and list
lead: Rank meals by what's on hand or expiring, and leave out items that are probably already on hand (P5, L5).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: This joins Phase 1 and Phase 2: fewer duplicate buys and less spoilage.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: 1. Confidence threshold for leaving an item off the list? Show these as "probably have: X" so they're easy to add back (recommended)?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Add a pantry term to the ranking score.
2. Subtract the estimate in list generation, with a "probably have" section.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; a real week's list skips items the owner agrees are on hand.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
